summary: 纳米技术让研究者能在原子和分子尺度上调控材料。文章从电子元件与日用品的改良出发，讨论能源、水处理、食品生产和医疗诊断治疗中的应用与前景。

paragraphs.brief: 纳米科学和纳米技术近来变得非常时髦。
sentences: Nanoscience and nanotechnology have become very fashionable in recent times.
纳米科学和纳米技术近来变得非常时髦。
Their prominence has inspired science fiction and raised a lot of hope and hype about the possibilities.
他们的突出地位激发了科幻小说并带来了很多希望和关于可能性的杂音。
But what exactly is nanotechnology?
但是什么是纳米技术？
Most definitions agree that it is the manufacture of structures that measure up to 100 nanometres (nm).
大多数定义都认为，是制造了测量最高达100纳米的结构。
The diameter of an atom is typically only two or three tenths of a nanometre while that of the human hair is around 1,000,000 nm.
原子的直径一般仅为一纳米的二到三十分，而人类毛发的直径约为1,000,000纳米。
Essentially, we are now able to build new structures from atoms and molecules as if we were using the bricks of a children’s construction toy.
基本上，我们现在能够从原子和分子中建造新的结构，仿佛我们在使用儿童建筑玩具的砖块。

paragraphs.brief: 他们开发的产品使用二氧化钛的纳米粒子，这些纳米粒子与元素锰混合在一起。
sentences: Most of the electronic consumer goods that we use today contain components that measure less than 100 nm.
我们今天使用的大多数电子消费品含有的部件量小于100纳米。
The lasers in our CD and DVD players make use of the properties of semiconductor layers that are just a few atoms in thickness, so we clearly are in the nanotechnology age.
我们的CD和DVD播放器中的激光利用了半导体层的特性，这些半导体层次的厚度只是几个原子，所以我们显然处于纳米技术时代。
There are many other everyday items that we take for granted that have nanoparticles in them.
还有很多其他的日常物品，我们理所当然地认为，这些物品中含有纳米粒子。
One of these is sunscreen.
其中一个是防晒霜
In the 1990s there were safety issues with many of the sunscreen products available, so scientists at Oxford University set about finding a solution.
1990年代，许多防晒霜产品都存在安全问题，因此牛津大学的科学家开始寻找解决办法。
The product they developed uses nanoparticles of titanium dioxide that are doped with the element manganese.
他们开发的产品使用二氧化钛的纳米粒子，这些纳米粒子与元素锰混合在一起。
This product is almost transparent to the eye when spread on the skin, and it is effective for much longer than many of the traditional preparations.
这种产品在皮肤上传播时几乎对眼睛透明，而且比许多传统制剂有效得多。
In this case, we see an example of nanotechnology providing a solution to an existing problem rather than opening up new product areas.
在此情况下，我们看到纳米技术为现有问题提供了解决办法，而不是开辟了新的产品领域。

paragraphs.brief: 利用纳米技术改造现有产品的技术也可以应用于服装、室内装饰、油漆和塑料，以改善其寿命。
sentences: The technique of using nanotechnology to adapt existing products can also be applied to garments, upholstery, paint, and plastics to improve their longevity.
利用纳米技术改造现有产品的技术也可以应用于服装、室内装饰、油漆和塑料，以改善其寿命。
Bearing this in mind, it is interesting to ask whether nanotechnology can help with some of the world’s major current issues.
考虑到这一点，人们很想知道纳米技术能否帮助解决世界当前的一些重大问题。
The recent growth in climate change awareness calls a range of things into question.
最近气候变化意识的提高引起一系列问题。
Can we use energy more effectively?
我们能更有效地利用能源吗？
Can we reduce the carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
我们可以减少大气中的二氧化碳吗？
Can we use and purify water more effectively?
我们能更有效地使用和净化水吗？
Can health care be improved?
保健能否得到改善？
Nanotechnology may very well provide the solutions.
纳米技术可以很好地提供解决办法。
There are few times in history when the application of science to improving the human condition has been so apparent.
历史上很少一次科学应用来改善人类状况如此明显。

paragraphs.brief: 我们已经在利用我们新发现的在原子和分子规模上操纵物质的能力，来制造新型太阳能电池和电池。
sentences: We are already making new types of solar cells and batteries by using our newfound ability to manipulate matter at the atomic and molecular scale.
我们已经在利用我们新发现的在原子和分子规模上操纵物质的能力，来制造新型太阳能电池和电池。
If we can capture some of the huge quantities of energy that arrive at the Earth’s surface from the Sun, and store it effectively, we can reduce the need for fossil fuel-based power stations.
如果我们能捕捉到从太阳到达地球表面的大量能量，并有效地储存这些能量，我们就能减少对化石燃料发电站的需求。
We are already using nanoparticles and nanoporous materials to capture harmful greenhouse gases, and we may possibly convert some of them back into fuel.
我们已经在使用纳米粒子和纳米物质来捕捉有害的温室气体，我们可能会将其中一些气体转化为燃料。
There are, however, many technical problems involved, and it will be another decade or so before some of these ideas are deployed.
然而，这方面涉及许多技术问题，在采用其中一些想法之前，还要再过十年左右。

paragraphs.brief: 水净化越来越具有挑战性，许多人认为，我们认为理所当然的水将比石油更有价值。
sentences: Water purification is increasingly challenging and many believe that water, which we take for granted, is going to become more valuable than oil.
水净化越来越具有挑战性，许多人认为，我们认为理所当然的水将比石油更有价值。
Currently we do not use water efficiently, and many industrial and food processes leave contamination in water that is potentially toxic and difficult to remove.
目前，我们没有有效地使用水，许多工业和食品流程将潜在的有毒和难以消除的污染留在水中。
Nanofiltration may provide the solution to these problems, and may also offer new routes to the desalination of brackish water and groundwater in some parts of the world.
纳米化可能为这些问题提供解决办法，也可能为世界某些地区咸水和地下水的淡化提供新的途径。

paragraphs.brief: 随着世界人口的增加，粮食生产和加工变得越来越重要。
sentences: Food production and processing are becoming more important as the world’s population increases.
随着世界人口的增加，粮食生产和加工变得越来越重要。
There are concerns that potentially harmful nano-products might enter the body via the gut.
人们担心，潜在的有害纳米产品可能会通过肠胃进入人体。

Such concerns are being addressed, but it is even more important to ask questions about how nanotechnology might increase the nutritious yield of food and be adapted to help preserve and package food.
这些问题正在得到解决，但更为重要的是，要问一问纳米技术如何能增加粮食的营养产量，以及如何加以调整，以帮助保存和包装粮食。

There is already evidence to show that it might also be helpful in the primary production of raw food materials, by way of better delivery of pesticides in the field and better extraction of protein and carbohydrates.
已有证据表明，通过更好地在野外运送杀虫剂和更好地提取蛋白质和碳水化合物，这也可能有助于初级生产原材料。

paragraphs.brief: 保健领域纳米技术的应用已经超过了十年前的期望。
sentences: Healthcare is an area where the application of nanotechnology is already exceeding the expectations of ten years ago.
保健领域纳米技术的应用已经超过了十年前的期望。

It is happening across several fronts: better appreciation of what the ‘natural’ nanoparticles circulating in body fluid do; better methods of delivering drugs to the body via nanoparticles that target the diseased body part; improvements to the diagnostic imaging techniques of ultrasound, magnetic resonance imaging and X-ray computerised tomography.
它正在几个方面发生：更好地理解“天然”纳米粒子在体液中流通的作用；通过针对病态身体部分的纳米粒子向身体提供药物的更好方法；改进超声波、磁共振成像和X光计算机成像学等诊断成像技术。

We are now at the threshold of a new subject, ‘theranostics’, whereby nanoparticles will first deliver the diagnostic information to the clinician and then, using the same particle, deliver a form of therapy.
纳米粒子将首先向临床医生提供诊断信息，然后再使用同样的粒子来提供一种治疗。

paragraphs.brief: 纳米技术是一种改变生命的技术，它能提高生活质量，使我们能够更有效地利用我们的资源，从而保护环境，并创造新的商业机会。
sentences: Nanotechnology is a life-changing technology, making the quality of life better, enabling us to make use of our resources more effectively, thereby protecting our environment, and creating new business opportunities.
纳米技术是一种改变生命的技术，它能提高生活质量，使我们能够更有效地利用我们的资源，从而保护环境，并创造新的商业机会。
There are many other examples in the world of ‘new materials’ that also make use of nanotechnology.
世界上还有许多“新材料”的例子也使用纳米技术。
The possibilities may well be limitless.
可能性可能是无限的。

items.en: a comparison between two of the world’s vital natural resources
items.zh: 比较世界两个重要自然资源
items.why: 题干中的 two of the world’s vital natural resources 指的是 water 和 oil。原文直接比较了水和石油的价值: 水可能会比石油更有价值。因此答案是 E。

items.en: a mention of how nanotechnology could be dangerous for humans
items.zh: 提及纳米技术对人类的危险
items.why: 题干中的 coula be dangerous for humans 对应原文 potentialy harmful nano-products might enter he boay。这里明确说纳米产品可能通过肠道进入人体，因此构成健康风险。答案是 F。

items.en: a claim that nanotechnology has influenced modern authors
items.zh: 纳米技术对现代作者产生了影响
items.why: 题干中的 modern authors 被原文具体化为 science fiction,也就是科幻文学/科幻小说作者。has influenced 对应 has inspired。所以答案是 A。

items.en: a reference to the fact that nanotechnology is achieving more than was anticipated a decade ago
items.zh: 提及纳米技术的成就超过十年前的预期
items.why: G段说医疗领域的纳米技术应用已经超过十年前的预期。

items.en: a suggestion that nanotechnology could provide financial as well as ecological benefits
items.zh: 纳米技术既能带来经济效益，又能带来生态效益的建议
items.why: H段把更有效地利用资源与保护环境、节省资金联系在一起，同时涵盖生态和经济收益。

items.en: an acknowledgement that more time is required to realise some of nanotechnology’s potential
items.zh: 承认需要更多时间来实现纳米技术的某些潜力
items.why: D段承认技术问题尚多，部分构想还需约十年才能投入应用。

items.en: Nanotechnology In the same way that a child may use ________, scientists are now able to create new structures by combining the smallest particles known to man.
items.zh: 就像孩子使用________一样，科学家现在可以把人类已知的最小粒子组合成新的结构。
items.why: 回到对应内容“基本上，我们现在能够从原子和分子中建造新的结构，仿佛我们在使用儿童建筑玩具的砖块”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: We can fully appreciate the microscopic scale of this work by comparing the exact ________ of one atom with that of a single human hair.
items.zh: 把单个原子的________与一根头发的同一指标作精确比较，就能直观感受到这项工作的微观尺度。
items.why: 回到对应内容“原子的直径一般仅为一纳米的二到三十分，而人类毛发的直径约为1,000,000纳米”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: For example, a long-lasting ________, widely available today, relies on minute nanoparticles for its effectiveness.
items.zh: 例如，如今很容易买到的一种长效________，就是靠微小的纳米颗粒发挥作用。
items.why: 回到对应内容“1990年代，许多防晒霜产品都存在安全问题，因此牛津大学的科学家开始寻找解决办法”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: Which TWO of the following statements does the writer make about nanotechnology and energy resources?
items.zh: 作者对纳米技术和能源的以下两个说法是什么？
correct: Further research is needed to turn nanotechnology into practical energy solutions.
需要进一步研究，将纳米技术转化为实际的能源解决办法。
Nanotechnology is being used to remove dangerous gases from the atmosphere.
纳米技术正被用于从大气中清除危险气体。

items.en: In which TWO ways does the writer think nanotechnology could improve food production?
items.zh: 作者认为纳米技术可以改善粮食生产的两种方式？
correct: by keeping food fresh for longer
保持食物的新鲜时间更长
by protecting food from insects better
保护食物免受昆虫的侵扰

pairs: could 和 potentially 都保留了可能性，dangerous 与 harmful 都指存在危害。
两处都指把微小单元组合为新结构，动词由 create 换成 build。
achieving more than was anticipated a decade ago
exceeding the expectations of ten years ago
生态益处具体指保护环境
be another decade or so before
还需要时间／还要再等约十年
points: 题干中的 modern authors 被原文具体化为 science fiction,也就是科幻文学/科幻小说作者。has influenced 对应 has inspired。所以答案是 A。
回到对应内容“1990年代，许多防晒霜产品都存在安全问题，因此牛津大学的科学家开始寻找解决办法”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: “that it is the manufacture of structures that measure up to 100 nanometres (nm”补足 agree 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 agree 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
The diameter of an atom is typically only two or three tenths of a nanometre ….
连接词 while 引出“while that of the human hair is around 1,000,000 nm”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
